panels.description: Stromverbrauch der Wärmepumpe im gewählten Zeitraum nach Betriebsart (FA_Status: 1 = Heizen, 4 = Warmwasser). 'Sonstiges' = Abtauen/übrige Status sowie Stunden ohne Status-Daten (Logging-Lücken). Bei M3 kommt die separate Brauchwasser-WP als eigener Anteil dazu. Quelle: WP-interner Zähler (erfasst keinen Steuer-/Standby-Strom).

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END) AS v FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT h, v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY h) AS kwh FROM e), m AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ww, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hz, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status NOT IN (0, 1, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oth FROM status_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'FA_Status' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.hz, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE 0 END)) AS "Heizen", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.ww, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE 0 END)) AS "Warmwasser", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.oth, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE d.kwh END)) AS "Sonstiges" FROM d LEFT JOIN m ON d.h = m.h WHERE d.kwh IS NOT NULL

WITH h AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hr, AVG(value_watt) AS w FROM power_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'Shelly' AND device = 'Warmwasser_M3' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(w) / 1000.0) AS "Warmwasser-WP" FROM h

panels.title: Stromverbrauch im Zeitraum – $location

panels.description: Durchschnittlicher Stromverbrauch pro Monat nach Betriebsart (Mittelwert der Monatswerte im gewählten Zeitraum; angebrochene Monate zählen als eigener Monat). Aufteilung wie im linken Donut.

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END) AS v FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT h, v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY h) AS kwh FROM e), m AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ww, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hz, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status NOT IN (0, 1, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oth FROM status_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'FA_Status' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1), mo AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', d.h) AS mon, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.hz, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS hz_kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.ww, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS ww_kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.oth, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE d.kwh END) AS oth_kwh FROM d LEFT JOIN m ON d.h = m.h WHERE d.kwh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(AVG(hz_kwh)) AS "Heizen", ROUND(AVG(ww_kwh)) AS "Warmwasser", ROUND(AVG(oth_kwh)) AS "Sonstiges" FROM mo

WITH h AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hr, AVG(value_watt) AS w FROM power_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'Shelly' AND device = 'Warmwasser_M3' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1), mo AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', hr) AS mon, SUM(w) / 1000.0 AS kwh FROM h GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(AVG(kwh)) AS "Warmwasser-WP" FROM mo

panels.title: Ø Stromverbrauch pro Monat – $location

panels.description: Gesamter Strom für die Wärmeerzeugung im Zeitraum: Haupt-WP (interner Zähler, stündliche Deltas) plus — nur bei M3 — die separate Brauchwasser-WP. Entspricht exakt der Summe der Segmente im linken Donut.

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END) AS v FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT h, v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY h) AS kwh FROM e), wp_mo AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', h) AS mon, SUM(kwh) AS kwh FROM d WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), hh AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hr, AVG(value_watt) AS w FROM power_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'Shelly' AND device = 'Warmwasser_M3' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1), ww_mo AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', hr) AS mon, SUM(w) / 1000.0 AS kwh FROM hh GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(wp_mo.kwh, 0) + COALESCE(ww_mo.kwh, 0))) AS "Gesamt" FROM wp_mo FULL OUTER JOIN ww_mo ON wp_mo.mon = ww_mo.mon

panels.title: Gesamt im Zeitraum

panels.description: Durchschnittlicher Strom für die Wärmeerzeugung pro Monat (Mittelwert der Monatswerte, inkl. separater Brauchwasser-WP bei M3). Entspricht exakt der Summe der Segmente im rechten Donut.

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END) AS v FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT h, v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY h) AS kwh FROM e), wp_mo AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', h) AS mon, SUM(kwh) AS kwh FROM d WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), hh AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hr, AVG(value_watt) AS w FROM power_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'Shelly' AND device = 'Warmwasser_M3' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1), ww_mo AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', hr) AS mon, SUM(w) / 1000.0 AS kwh FROM hh GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(wp_mo.kwh, 0) + COALESCE(ww_mo.kwh, 0))) AS "Ø pro Monat" FROM wp_mo FULL OUTER JOIN ww_mo ON wp_mo.mon = ww_mo.mon

panels.title: Ø pro Monat (Gesamt)

panels.description: Arbeitszahl über den gewählten Zeitraum: Wärmemenge geteilt durch elektrische Energie (WP-interner Zähler). Hinweis: Der Zähler Waermemenge_Heizen enthält in M1 auch die Warmwasser-Wärme — die JAZ ist damit die Gesamt-Arbeitszahl der WP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Waermemenge_Heizen' THEN value_cumulated_kwh END) - MIN(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Waermemenge_Heizen' THEN value_cumulated_kwh END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' THEN CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END END) - MIN(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' THEN CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END END), 0) AS "JAZ" FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND device = 'Waermepumpe' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0

panels.title: JAZ im Zeitraum

panels.description: Aktueller kumulierter Zählerstand der Wärmepumpe (elektrische Gesamtenergie, WP-intern).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value_cumulated_kwh AS "Zählerstand" FROM energy_values WHERE sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND device = 'Waermepumpe' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Zählerstand Strom aktuell

panels.description: Aufteilung des WP-Stromverbrauchs nach Betriebsart über den CAN-Status FA_Status (1 = Heizen, 4 = Warmwasser; validiert: im Sommer tritt nur noch Status 4 auf). Stundenweise Energie-Deltas (LAG über den kumulierten Zähler) werden anteilig nach den Status-Samples der Stunde zugeordnet. 'Sonstiges' = Abtauen/übrige Status sowie Stunden ohne Status-Daten (Logging-Lücken, z. B. März 2026 ~48 kWh). 'Warmwasser-WP' ist die eigene Brauchwasser-WP in M3, integriert aus power_values (die energy_values dieses Geräts sind fehlerhaft — Connector-Bug); in M1 bleibt diese Serie leer. M3-Haupt-WP macht nie Warmwasser (Status 4 kommt dort nicht vor).

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END) AS v FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT h, v - LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY h) AS kwh FROM e), m AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ww, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hz, SUM(CASE WHEN value_status NOT IN (0, 1, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oth FROM status_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'FA_Status' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', d.h), '%Y-%m') AS "Monat", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.hz, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Heizen", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.ww, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Warmwasser", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0) > 0 THEN d.kwh * COALESCE(m.oth, 0) / (COALESCE(m.ww, 0) + COALESCE(m.hz, 0) + COALESCE(m.oth, 0)) ELSE d.kwh END), 1) AS "Sonstiges" FROM d LEFT JOIN m ON d.h = m.h WHERE d.kwh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS hr, AVG(value_watt) AS w FROM power_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'Shelly' AND device = 'Warmwasser_M3' AND location = '$location' GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', hr), '%Y-%m') AS "Monat", ROUND(SUM(w) / 1000.0, 1) AS "Warmwasser-WP" FROM h GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stromverbrauch nach Betriebsart – $location

panels.description: Vergleich der drei Messquellen pro Monat: WP-interner Stromzähler (CAN), Summe der beiden Shelly-Stromkreise der WP (robust über stündliche LAG-Deltas, gefiltert gegen den Zähler-Glitch im April 2026) und die erzeugte Wärmemenge. Die Shelly-Summe liegt systematisch über dem CAN-Zähler — die Differenz ist Steuerungs-/Standby-Verbrauch, den der WP-interne Zähler nicht erfasst (in M3 im Sommer: 11–13 kWh/Monat bei CAN = 0). Der Zähler Waermemenge_Heizen enthält in M1 auch die Warmwasser-Wärme.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', time), '%Y-%m') AS "Monat", ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END) - MIN(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END), 1) AS "Strom (WP-Zähler)" FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' AND location = '$location' AND device = 'Waermepumpe' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH e AS (SELECT device, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', time) AS h, MAX(CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10000 THEN value_cumulated_kwh END) AS v FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'Shelly' AND device IN ('Wärmepumpe', 'Wärmepumpe ST') AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2), d AS (SELECT device, h, v - LAG(v) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY h) AS kwh FROM e) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', h), '%Y-%m') AS "Monat", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kwh > 0 AND kwh < 50 THEN kwh ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "Stromkreise (Shelly)" FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', time), '%Y-%m') AS "Monat", ROUND(MAX(value_cumulated_kwh) - MIN(value_cumulated_kwh), 1) AS "Wärmemenge" FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND measurement = 'Waermemenge_Heizen' AND location = '$location' AND device = 'Waermepumpe' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Strom & Wärmemenge im Vergleich – $location

panels.description: Monatliche Arbeitszahl: Wärmemenge geteilt durch Stromverbrauch (beides WP-interne Zähler). In M1 enthält die Wärmemenge auch Warmwasser — die JAZ ist die Gesamt-Arbeitszahl. Monate ohne WP-Betrieb (M3 im Sommer) bleiben leer (NULLIF gegen Division durch 0).

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', time), '%Y-%m') AS "Monat", (MAX(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Waermemenge_Heizen' THEN value_cumulated_kwh END) - MIN(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Waermemenge_Heizen' THEN value_cumulated_kwh END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' THEN CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END END) - MIN(CASE WHEN measurement = 'Elektrische_Gesamtenergie_WEZ_MWh' THEN CASE WHEN value_cumulated_kwh < 10 THEN value_cumulated_kwh * 1000 ELSE value_cumulated_kwh END END), 0) AS "JAZ" FROM energy_values WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND sensor_type = 'CanGateway' AND device = 'Waermepumpe' AND location = '$location' AND value_cumulated_kwh > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monatliche Arbeitszahl (JAZ) – $location
